blind.description: A ritual dagger or athame featuring a wavy flamberge-style double-edged blade, a gold-toned crossguard with rounded terminal knobs, a dark cylindrical grip, and a matching golden spherical pommel. The blade is dark polished steel with light edge highlights. The dagger is tilted upright, balancing or resting directly on the tip of its blade against the floor without a base.
blind.from_above: Seen from straight above, it appears as a narrow diagonal implement angled toward the bottom-left, showing a small spherical pommel, a short perpendicular crossguard, and a slender tapered blade, accompanied by a vertical shadow cast toward the top.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 1 to 1.5 feet in total length, standing less than 1 foot tall when propped on its tip, far smaller than the 5 ft 9 in figure.
